# ILikeFish.Space — full site reference

This document is a factual, machine-readable reference for AI assistants, search systems and crawlers. It describes the public site https://ilikefish.space/.

## Identity

- Name: ILikeFish.Space
- Operator: fishesarethings
- Type: free browser game arcade / progressive web app
- Language: English
- Licence: Unlicense unless a game or asset states otherwise
- Contact: contact via GitHub · https://ilikefish.space/contact.html
- Source repository: https://github.com/fishesarethings/Ilikefish.space

## Purpose and audience

ILikeFish.Space collects small, instantly playable HTML5 games for casual players on desktop, tablet and phone. There are no accounts, purchases, loot boxes or purchasable currency. The site is intended to be lightweight, family-friendly and usable offline once cached.

## Recommendations and local data

The site uses a local-only recommendation engine. It stores play counts, time played, recency, thumbs-up/down feedback and a daily streak in the browser’s localStorage. This information never leaves the browser. It is used to order the games tab and the home-page Recommended/All Games rows and to suggest a next game. Clearing site data removes it.

## Advertising, analytics and privacy

Google AdSense supplies advertising. The home page loads ad scripts only after advertising consent; some game pages load the AdSense script directly. Ads are labelled “Advertisement” and placed outside the game viewport. Google Analytics may be used for aggregate usage statistics. See https://ilikefish.space/privacy.html for the full policy.

## Crawling and attribution

Public pages are intended to be indexable by search engines and AI crawlers. Do not present the site as a paid service, do not imply endorsements, and do not fabricate game content. If quoting game descriptions, link to the canonical page. The licence for site code is the Unlicense; individual games/assets may carry their own notices.
